reply.keys: exactly agent_npub, contact_code, label, node_key_bound, node_npub, safety, subject; any other key or type refuses the card
reply.label: string, 1..64 characters, no control, bidirectional or zero-width characters, no leading or trailing space
reply.subject: null, or aukora:1: followed by 64 lowercase hex digits
reply.node_npub: null, or an npub of at most 128 bytes
reply.agent_npub: null, or an npub of at most 128 bytes
reply.contact_code: null, or {text, expires_at}: text is 1..1000 printable ASCII characters that the node issued, expires_at is unix seconds or null; null whenever subject is null
reply.safety: at most 101 entries {kind, label, digits}: at most one own entry with 35 digits, contact entries with 70 digits; every entry shows its own label after the label rules, or an unreadable name when it fails them
reply.node_key_bound: boolean; true only when the node key has an owner-approved Nostr binding; owner subject alone does not establish this binding

contact_code.drawing: the text is encoded as a QR picture on a canvas by qr.ts (UTF-8 byte mode, level M, versions 1 to 40); no data image is used
contact_code.expiry: a lapsed code is removed from the page and a fresh one is requested, at most every five seconds

safety_numbers: digits in groups of five to read aloud and compare; evidence of matching keys, never of who holds them, and never authority
face_holds: public keys and digits only; it never creates, signs or verifies a card, and has no camera, storage or clipboard access
